canonical_source.title: Munda mimetic reduplication
canonical_source.container: Canadian Journal of Linguistics / Revue canadienne de linguistique
canonical_source.mundari_relevance: direct: article states that its empirical typology includes both Kera Mundari and Mundari among seven Munda languages

verified: scope including Kera Mundari and Mundari

canonicalization.manifestation_rule: Cambridge abstract/shared-read-only pages, Swarthmore metadata record, library links, and third-party mirrors are manifestations or descriptions of one article and must not be counted as independent sources.
canonicalization.variety_rule: Kera Mundari and Mundari observations must retain the article's own variety labels; do not silently merge them into an undifferentiated Mundari claim.
canonicalization.independence_rule: A passage or lexical item is independent corroboration only after its own provenance/citation is inspected. Material attributed to earlier grammars, dictionaries, consultants, field records, or cited publications inherits that dependency.

access_rights.cambridge_access_observed: shared/read-only representation is discoverable; Cambridge describes it as read-only and directs users to access options/content-sharing policy
access_rights.swarthmore_access_observed: institutional metadata record exposes a Full Text/library navigation link but the census did not establish a redistribution licence for article text

evidence_promotion.reason: Metadata and topical relevance are verified, but this run did not establish a permitted immutable full-text artifact, local SHA-256, exact page/passage locator, passage-level upstream provenance, or any necessary participant/cultural reuse basis.
required_before_promotion: obtain a lawful immutable article manifestation where permitted
inspect candidate Mundari/Kera Mundari passages and examples at exact locators
classify each candidate as author-primary, cited-source-derived, mixed, or unresolved
record applicable reuse basis and preserve participant/consultant/cultural uncertainty

blocked_or_unresolved: No unrestricted redistribution licence for article text was established in this run.
Exact provenance of individual Mundari and Kera Mundari examples was not audited from full text.
Any participant/consultant consent and culturally sensitive reuse constraints remain unresolved until source methods/acknowledgements and underlying data provenance are inspected.
audit_invariants: peer-reviewed publication != permission to redistribute source text or underlying elicited material
comparative article mentioning Mundari != every proposition is Mundari-specific evidence
Kera Mundari != automatically interchangeable with other Mundari varieties

release_effect.note: Do not change controlled MMSC/evidence/module counts until deterministic ledger reconciliation. This audit adds a verified source identity/lead only and promotes no claim or evidence record.
